title: Split bytes into content-defined chunks — dedup_chunk
code: x <- as.raw(sample(0:255, 200000, replace = TRUE)) chunks <- dedup_chunk(x) head(chunks) #>   offset length #> 1      0   6417 #> 2   6417   7155 #> 3  13572  17779 #> 4  31351  10520 #> 5  41871   9488 #> 6  51359  13335 sum(chunks$length) == length(x) #> [1] TRUE  # An insertion near the start leaves the later boundaries in place. y <- c(as.raw(1:100), x) tail(dedup_chunk(y)$offset - 100) %in% dedup_chunk(x)$offset #> [1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE

title: Conditions raised by zudedup — zudedup-conditions
text: Every error zudedup raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zudedup_error.

title: Conditions raised by zudedup — zudedup-conditions
text: zudedup_invalid_argument argument unusable: chunking parameters range, malformed manifest, unknown hash algorithm, backend without function operation needs. condition carries arg, argument fault. zudedup_store_error chunk missing store, bytes hash name, store unusable. condition carries hash, chunk's digest, index, 1-based position manifest, apply. zudedup_algorithm_error manifest's hash algorithm chunking parameters differ store's another manifest's. zudedup_io_error connection file read written. zudedup_limit_error limit reached. condition carries limit, argument's name, "max_chunks", limit_value.
